topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the topic of complement and frames expectations regarding its complexity and terminology.

topics.label: Foundational principles and core component of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics provide foundational knowledge on the general organization, naming conventions, and central role of component C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three upstream recognition pathways that converge to trigger complement activation on target surfaces.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the downstream immune actions executed by activated complement products to eliminate pathogens.

topics.label: Regulation of complement and host protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that prevent complement from damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the diverse clinical presentations and disease phenotypes resulting from deficiencies in individual complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the evolutionary strategies used by pathogens to resist and inhibit complement attack.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on the adaptive immune system.
